disposition.reason: Python BacktestReadThroughCache owns source-version calculation, cache fill, WAL/content visibility check and D091 coverage publication. A separate Java writer would create a competing generation or an unreceipted slice.
disposition.java_surface: Fourteen-field typed READ-only definition, complete versioned key, bounded repository and ReadGroup binding.
disposition.write_rejection: DatasetDefinition declares READ only; WRITE capability check rejects direct Java writes.

contract.time_semantics: Exchange business date in a UTC-midnight TIMESTAMP carrier, not an event instant.
contract.numeric_semantics: Unadjusted CNY/share prices and limits; Tushare volume in lots and amount in thousand CNY; dimensionless adjustment factor.
contract.source_version: Lowercase SHA-256 of the current view definition and relevant source table/partition state.

python_owner.read_path: _cached validates coverage, matching row count, unique (trade_date, ts_code) keys and pandas content digest for one version.
python_owner.miss_path: read fetches v_backtest_daily after checking source fingerprint, writes the versioned cache, waits for WAL/content visibility and publishes D091 coverage.
python_owner.checkpoint: No independent Java source-ingest checkpoint applies.

target.reason_no_isolated_write_target: Only the Python owner may publish the versioned cache and coverage; D092 validates a real stored version with SELECT only.

read_acceptance.database_access: Configured local QuestDB over JDBC; SELECT only.
read_acceptance.compared_against: D091 complete cache slice independently verified by Python owner content_digest.

known_limitations: The verified historical source_version is stale relative to the current view/source fingerprint, so current-version reads will cache miss and Python may rebuild; this writing path was not invoked.
The acceptance covers the latest stored date and its complete 5,565-row versioned slice, not every historical version.
Java intentionally does not publish, repair or refresh cache data; human semantic review remains pending.
